js: (function(){var T=__dbg.THREE,bed=__dbg.bed;bed.updateMatrixWorld(true);var bb=new T.Box3().setFromObject(bed);var rc=new T.Raycaster(),down=new T.Vector3(0,-1,0),hits=[],N=11;for(var i=0;i<N;i++)for(var j=0;j<N;j++){var x=bb.min.x+(i+0.5)/N*(bb.max.x-bb.min.x),z=bb.min.z+(j+0.5)/N*(bb.max.z-bb.min.z);rc.set(new T.Vector3(x,bb.max.y+3,z),down);var hs=rc.intersectObject(bed,true),top=null;for(var k=0;k<hs.length;k++){if(!hs[k].object.visible)continue;if(top===null||hs[k].point.y>top)top=hs[k].point.y;}if(top!==null)hits.push(+(top-bed.position.y).toFixed(3));}var s=hits.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});var hist={};hits.forEach(function(v){var b=(Math.round(v*20)/20).toFixed(2);hist[b]=(hist[b]||0)+1;});var mode=Object.keys(hist).sort(function(a,b){return hist[b]-hist[a];})[0];return JSON.stringify({rays:hits.length,min:s[0],p25:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.25)],median:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.5)],p75:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.75)],max:s[s.length-1],mode:mode,modeN:hist[mode],target:+(__rig.rig.bed.top-bed.position.y).toFixed(3)});})()
